episodes.synopsis: Shino, Sosuke, and Genpachi go to the Imamura doll maker to pick up a set of dolls for the elite church member's order.
episodes.title: Doll

episodes.synopsis: Shino confronts Nachi about the magical barrier around Daikaku's house. Meanwhile, the young boy runs off and Shino chases after him.
episodes.title: Molding

episodes.synopsis: Shino is forced to teach children how to read and write at the church, where he is shunned by most of the children.
episodes.title: Reverse Flow

episodes.synopsis: The "other" Sousuke asks a black haired girl, "Do you want me to set you free?" Meanwhile, Satomi is discussing a new rumor of corpses suddenly appearing out of nowhere.
episodes.title: Ignorance

episodes.synopsis: Sousuke and the "other" Sousuke, Ao, fight, with Shino desperately trying to stop them.
episodes.title: In Homage

episodes.synopsis: Nachi's black panther decides to leave the house, feeling that it is too crowded. Shino goes and finds him with Genpachi.
episodes.title: Reminiscence

episodes.synopsis: Dousetsu comes to the capital in search of his sister. He meets Shino in the Konaya inn.
episodes.title: Chance Encounters

episodes.synopsis: Shino is sent to a place called Ikura to investigate a case of Kamikakushi by Satomi, saying that the child came back in the same age as he was when he was spirited away.
episodes.title: Spirited Away

episodes.synopsis: Shinobu is taken away by the Tengu which live in the mountains. Shino and Sousuke follow him, only to be stopped by Ao, who tells Shino that the princess will be revived in a short time and that Shino will never be able to collect all the beads before that.
episodes.title: Encompassing Heavens

episodes.synopsis: Shinobu awakens to his Tengu lineage as Ao threatens Hazuki. Shino and Sosuke finally gathers all 8 bead holders, while something is starting to affect Sosuke.
episodes.title: Twin Moons

episodes.synopsis: Shinobu arrives at the Konna-ya, gathering all eight bead holders, but still missing Sosuke's Bead of Duty. Meanwhile, Keno and Rio inform Shino of Sosuke's condition, caused by his Bead of Duty seemingly choosing Ao as its rightful holder.
episodes.title: Crossroads

episodes.synopsis: As Sosuke's condition worsens, Shino and the others head for the Old Church after learning of Ao's business there. To their shock, they discover that Tamazusa was already waiting for them.
episodes.title: Pursuit

episodes.synopsis: Ao makes an attempt to take Shino away so the Ritual would not happen betraying Tamazusa. Due to Shino's strong wishes, Sosuke wakes up from his comatose state therefore stopping the Ritual.
episodes.title: Destiny
